split.note: Holdout scene ids are declared here, as data. Tuning code must read the 'calibration' list; it must never name a holdout scene. A 'recorded' scene is captured and committed and read by nothing: no fit, no self-check, no bound and no claim may cite it.

confidenceBought.note: probability a state held by fraction p of draws would have been seen at least once in 7 runs
